data.value:
SRP (Philippine / typical market base price): Approx. ₱1,568,000 – ₱2,500,000 (Varies by trim, drivetrain, and configuration)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 4,825 × 1,815 × 1,835 Wheelbase (mm): 2,800 Seating Capacity: 7
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine Options:
2.4 L 4-Cylinder Turbo Diesel (MIVEC)
Maximum Output: ~181 hp Maximum Torque: ~430 Nm
Transmission: 8-speed Automatic or 6-speed Manual (depending on variant) Drivetrain: 2WD or 4WD (Super Select 4WD-II on higher variants)
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: Up to ~3,100 kg (braked, variant-dependent)
Payload Capacity: Approx. 650–700 kg
Fuel Tank Capacity: 68 L
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 7 (three-row SUV)
Infotainment: Touchscreen infotainment system with smartphone connectivity (size varies by trim)
Speakers: 4–8 (depending on variant)
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: Ventilated Disc / Disc
Suspension: Double Wishbone front, Multi-Link rear with coil springs
Tires / Wheels: 18” Alloy Wheels (standard), 20” Alloy Wheels on higher trims
Ground Clearance: Approx. 218 mm
